text: Northwind Analytics pricing, effective January 2025. Starter plan: $49 per month. Growth plan: $99 per month. Pro plan: $199 per month. Enterprise plan: custom pricing. All plans are billed monthly. Prices are in USD.
title: Pricing (current, January 2025)

text: Northwind Analytics pricing archive, June 2024. Monthly price list. Starter plan monthly price: $29 per month. Growth plan monthly price: $49 per month. Pro plan monthly price: $99 per month. These monthly prices were replaced by the January 2025 price list.
title: Pricing archive (June 2024)

text: Refunds: customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days. No partial-month refunds are given.
title: Refund policy

text: Enterprise plan features: single sign-on (SSO), a dedicated support manager, custom data retention, and a 99.9% uptime SLA. Enterprise customers also get priority onboarding.
title: Enterprise plan features

text: Onboarding: new workspaces activate in three steps. Invite your team, connect a data source, and run your first report. Activation usually takes less than one business day.
title: Onboarding guide

text: API rate limits per day: Starter 1,000 requests per day, Growth 5,000 requests per day, Pro 10,000 requests per day, Enterprise unlimited requests per day.
title: API rate limits

text: Churn: subscriptions cancelled before the renewal date stop at the end of the current billing period. Cancelled workspaces keep read access for 30 days.
title: Cancellation and churn

text: Data retention: Starter 90 days, Growth 1 year, Pro 3 years, Enterprise custom retention. Deleted data cannot be recovered.
title: Data retention

text: Support SLAs: Starter email support within 2 business days, Growth within 1 business day, Pro within 4 hours, Enterprise within 1 hour with a dedicated manager.
title: Support SLAs

text: Security: Northwind Analytics is SOC 2 Type II certified. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. SSO is available on the Enterprise plan only.
title: Security and compliance
